muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿ن﴾: the discussion of the disconnected letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.
﴿والقلم﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; «القلم» is that by which the oath is sworn (muqsam bihi); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being «أقسم» (I swear).
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is relative or maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); in either case it is conjoined to «القلم».
﴿يسطرون﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted; the clause ﴿يسطرون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿ما﴾: the Ḥijāzī negating [«ما»], which governs as «ليس» does.
﴿أنت﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the noun of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿بنعمة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the negated clause, the bāʾ thus being causal (sababiyya).
﴿ربك﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿بمجنون﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿مجنون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and made genitive (majrūr) in form by the bāʾ; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وإن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause with what follows it is conjoined to the clause that answers the oath; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿لك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿لأجرا﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «أجرًا» is the noun of «إن».
﴿غير﴾: a naʿt (adjective).
﴿ممنون﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿وإنك﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun.
﴿لعلى خلق﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «على خلق» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿عظيم﴾: a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿فستبصر﴾: the fāʾ is «استثنائية» (exceptive) «[Translator's note: so in the source; probably a slip for «استئنافية» (resumptive).]»; the sīn is a particle of the future; «تبصر» is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت» (you).
﴿ويبصرون﴾: conjoined to ﴿ستبصر﴾.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿بأيكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); «أي» is an interrogative noun, and «كم» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿المفتون﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), in the nominative (marfūʿ); the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿تبصر﴾.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿إن ربك﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «رب» is its noun, and the kāf is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿هو﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أعلم﴾: the khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of «إن». Or ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and «أعلم» is the khabar of «إن».
﴿بمن﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾.
﴿ضل﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) past verb, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the clause ﴿ضل﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿عن سبيله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ضل﴾; the clause has no grammatical position, because it gives the reason (taʿlīl) for what precedes.
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿أعلم﴾: the khabar.
﴿بالمهتدين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعلم﴾.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), because it conjoins to an omitted [clause] indicated by the context; «لا» is prohibitive.
﴿تطع﴾: an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by «لا»; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت» (you).
﴿المكذبين﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿ودوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is joined to the wāw of the plural.
﴿لو﴾: maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya).
﴿تدهن﴾: an imperfect verb, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir).
﴿فيدهنون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «يدهنون» is an imperfect verb, conjoined to «تدهن», so it falls within the scope of «لو» and is part of what is wished for; what is wished for is two things, the second of them caused by the first. Or it is the khabar (predicate) of an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «فهم مدهنون» (so they would be compromising).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is prohibitive.
﴿تطع﴾: an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by «لا».
﴿كل﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿حلاف﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿مهين﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حلاف﴾.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿هماز مشاء﴾: two adjectives (ṣifa) of ﴿حلاف﴾, made genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.
﴿بنميم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مشاء﴾.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿مناع﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿حلاف﴾, made genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.
﴿للخير﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مناع﴾.
﴿معتد أثيم﴾: likewise two adjectives of ﴿حلاف﴾.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿عتل﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿حلاف﴾, made genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.
﴿بعد﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿زنيم﴾.
﴿ذلك﴾: a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿زنيم﴾: an adjective of ﴿حلاف﴾, made genitive by the kasra.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿أن﴾: maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); it, together with what falls within its scope, is in the place of an accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: «لأن كان» (because he was); and it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) what «إذا تتلى» indicates, i.e.: he denied them. It is not valid for it to be governed by the verb of the protasis, because «إذا» is annexed to the clause after it, and the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) does not govern what precedes the muḍāf; nor is it valid for it to be governed by «قال», which is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because what comes after the conditional particle does not govern what precedes it.
﴿كان﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هم» (they) «[Translator's note: so in the source; the latent pronoun is singular, «هو» (he).]».
﴿ذا﴾: its khabar (predicate).
﴿مال﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وبنين﴾: conjoined to «مال».

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿إذا﴾: an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition; it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) its apodosis (jawāb).
﴿تتلى﴾: an imperfect verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive).
﴿عليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تتلى﴾; the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿آياتنا﴾: the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), made nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma, and ﴿نا﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿قال﴾: a past verb, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the clause «قال» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿أساطير﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «هي أساطير» (they are tales).
﴿الأولين﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿سنسمه﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; the sīn is a particle of the future; «نسمه» is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿على الخرطوم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نسمه﴾.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿إنا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun.
﴿بلوناهم﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar, i.e.: «مثل ما بلونا» (like what We tried); ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); ﴿بلونا﴾ is a past verb and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil; and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما﴾ and the verb is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿بلونا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil.
﴿أصحاب﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿الجنة﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إذ﴾: an adverb of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بلونا﴾.
﴿أقسموا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿ليصرمنها﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; «يصرمنها» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of like letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil, i.e.: «ليصرموننها».
﴿مصبحين﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ﴿ليصرمنها﴾; it is an active participle of the complete (tāmma) «أصبح».

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) or circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «لا» is the negating one.
﴿يستثنون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs (al-afʿāl al-khamsa); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿ولا يستثنون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or circumstantial, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿فطاف﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «طاف» is a past verb.
﴿عليها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿طاف﴾.
﴿طائف﴾: the fāʿil (agent).
﴿من ربك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿طائف﴾.
﴿وهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «هم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿نائمون﴾: the khabar (predicate), made nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿فأصبحت﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «أصبحت» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun being latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هي» (it).
﴿كالصريم﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أصبح﴾, and ﴿الصريم﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿فتنادوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «تنادوا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿مصبحين﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), made accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ, because it is a sound masculine plural.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿أن﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya).
﴿اغدوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperative verb, and the wāw is its noun.
﴿على حرثكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اغدوا﴾. The clause ﴿اغدوا...﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿كنتم﴾: a defective past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is the noun of «كان».
﴿صارمين﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «كان», made accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: «إن كنتم صارمين فاغدوا» (if you would harvest, then go early).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿فانطلقوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «انطلقوا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿وهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «هم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يتخافتون﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿يتخافتون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿وهم يتخافتون﴾ is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿أن﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya), because whispering contains the meaning of saying without its letters; the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا﴾: prohibitive.
﴿يدخلنها﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of a jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive «لا»; ﴿ها﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa).
﴿اليوم﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يدخلنها﴾.
﴿عليكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿يدخلنها﴾.
﴿مسكين﴾: the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿وغدوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «غدوا» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun.
﴿على حرد﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قادرين﴾.
﴿قادرين﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «غدوا». Or «غدوا» is complete (tāmma), and «قادرين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «غدوا», with ﴿على حرد﴾ attached to it. Or ﴿على حرد﴾ is the ḥāl, and «قادرين» is a second ḥāl, or a ḥāl from the pronoun of the first ḥāl, so that it is an overlapping ḥāl (ḥāl mutadākhila).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿فلما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «لما» is temporal (ḥīniyya), or linking.
﴿رأوها﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿قالوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿إنا﴾: «إن» [and] its noun «[Translator's note: so worded in the source: «إن اسمها»; i.e. «إنّ» is an abrogating particle and «نا» is its noun.]».
﴿لضالون﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «ضالون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «إن», its noun and its khabar are the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿بل﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction.
﴿نحن﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿محرومون﴾: the khabar (predicate), made nominative by the wāw.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿قال﴾: a past verb.
﴿أوسطهم﴾: the fāʿil (agent).
﴿ألم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disavowal (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and «لم» is a particle of negation, of conversion [to the past] and of the jussive.
﴿أقل﴾: an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾.
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقل﴾.
﴿لولا﴾: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), i.e.: «هلّا» (why not).
﴿تسبحون﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; its object is omitted, i.e. the Name of Majesty.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿قالوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿سبحان﴾: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), made accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb.
﴿ربنا﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إنا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun.
﴿كنّا﴾: «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun.
﴿ظالمين﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «كان»; the clause ﴿كنا ظالمين﴾ is the khabar of «إن», and the clause «إنّا كنّا» gives the reason (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿فأقبل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «أقبل» is a past verb.
﴿بعضهم﴾: the fāʿil (agent).
﴿على بعض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقبل﴾.
﴿يتلاومون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿قالوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle.
﴿ويلنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, in the accusative (manṣūb).
﴿إنا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun.
﴿كنّا﴾: «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun.
﴿طاغين﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «كان»; the clause ﴿كنا طاغين﴾ is the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿عسى﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, one of the verbs of hope (afʿāl al-rajāʾ).
﴿ربنا﴾: the noun of «عسى».
﴿أن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) that makes the noun accusative and the khabar nominative «[Translator's note: so in the source; «أن» here is the maṣdar-forming particle that makes the imperfect verb accusative, as the next line indicates.]».
﴿يبدلنا﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and ﴿نا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أن» together with what falls within its scope is the khabar (predicate) of «عسى».
﴿خيرًا﴾: a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿منها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خيرًا﴾.
﴿إنا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun.
﴿إلى ربنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿راغبون﴾.
﴿راغبون﴾: the khabar of «إنّ».

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address.
﴿العذاب﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ولعذاب﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); and «عذاب» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿الآخرة﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿أكبر﴾: the khabar. The clause ﴿ولعذاب...﴾ is circumstantial, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), or resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿لو﴾: conditional.
﴿كانوا﴾: «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun.
﴿يعلمون﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar of «كان», and the apodosis (jawāb) of «لو» is omitted.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿للمتقين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿عند﴾: the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «جنات», or attached to the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached.
﴿ربهم﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿جنات﴾: the postponed noun of «إن».
﴿النعيم﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿أفنجعل﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disavowal (al-istifhām al-inkārī); the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to an implied [clause] that the context requires, i.e.: «أنحيف في الحكم فنجعل المسلمين كالكافرين» (shall We be unjust in judgement and make the Muslims like the disbelievers?); ﴿نجعل﴾ is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir).
﴿المسلمين﴾: the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿كالمجرمين﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the second mafʿūl bihi, and ﴿المجرمين﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿كيف﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿تحكمون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause «تحكمون» is a badal (substitute) from the clause ﴿ما لكم﴾.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿أم﴾: a conjunction for transitional digression (al-iḍrāb al-intiqālī), and the hamza implied in it is for the interrogative of disavowal and rebuke (al-istifhām al-inkārī al-tawbīkhī).
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿كتاب﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿فيه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تدرسون﴾.
﴿تدرسون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿تدرسون...﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿فيه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿لما﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), brought for emphasis; and «ما» is the postponed noun of «إن».
﴿تخيرون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿تخيرون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿أم﴾: a conjunction for transitional digression (al-iḍrāb al-intiqālī), and the hamza implied in it is for the interrogative of disavowal and rebuke (al-istifhām al-inkārī al-tawbīkhī).
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿أيمان﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿علينا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أيمان﴾.
﴿بالغة﴾: a second adjective.
﴿إلى يوم القيامة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) to which the khabar, namely «لكم», is attached; or to «بالغة», i.e.: reaching to that day and ending at it; ﴿القيامة﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إن﴾: the clause is the answer to the oath that is understood (malḥūẓ), so it has no grammatical position; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of «إن».
﴿لما﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), brought for emphasis; and «ما» is the postponed noun of «إن».
﴿تحكمون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿تحكمون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿سلهم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «سَلْ» is an imperative verb with its latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and ﴿هم﴾ is its first object.
﴿أيّهم﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject), the pronoun being in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation.
﴿بذلك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿زعيم﴾.
﴿زعيم﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «أيّهم»; the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the second object of «سَلْ», because it takes two objects in the accusative.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿أم﴾: a conjunction for transitional digression (al-iḍrāb al-intiqālī), and the hamza implied in it is for the interrogative of disavowal and rebuke (al-istifhām al-inkārī al-tawbīkhī).
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿شركاء﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); this clause is conjoined in meaning to the clause «أيّهم بذلك زعيم».
﴿فليأتوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); the lām is the lām of command; «يأتوا» is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by the lām, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿بشركائهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتوا﴾.
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿كانوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is its noun.
﴿صادقين﴾: the khabar of «كان»; the apodosis (jawāb) is omitted, indicated by what precedes, i.e.: «فليأتوا بشركائهم» (then let them bring their partners).

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿يوم﴾: an adverb, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied (muqaddar) «أذكر» (remember), or it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) His saying: ﴿فليأتوا﴾.
﴿يكشف﴾: a clause in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it; «يكشف» is an imperfect verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive).
﴿عن ساق﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿ويدعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يدعون» is an imperfect verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil.
﴿إلى السجود﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يدعون﴾.
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «لا» is negating.
﴿يستطيعون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿خاشعة﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of «يدعون».
﴿أبصارهم﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «خاشعة», the pronoun being in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation.
﴿ترهقهم﴾: a second ḥāl; «ترهقهم» is an imperfect verb, and the pronoun is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ذلّة﴾: a postponed fāʿil.
﴿وقد﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq).
﴿كانوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun.
﴿يدعون﴾: a verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil «[Translator's note: so in the source; here «يدعون» is passive and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil, as in the previous verse.]»; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «كانوا».
﴿إلى السجود﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يدعون﴾.
﴿وهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and «هم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿سالمون﴾: the khabar, made nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿فذرني﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, or [the fāʾ] al-faṣīḥa, because it is the answer to an implied condition, the implied form being: «إذا كانت أحوالهم كذلك فذرني» (if their states are like that, then leave Me [with them]); «ذر» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the yāʾ is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ومن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «من» is conjoined to the yāʾ; or the wāw is for accompaniment (maʿiyya), and «من» is in the position of an accusative as a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); the first is preferable.
﴿يكذب﴾: an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being latent; the clause ﴿يكذب﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿بهذا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يكذب﴾.
﴿الحديث﴾: a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative.
﴿سنستدرجهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the sīn is for the future; «نستدرجهم» is an imperfect verb with a latent fāʿil, and the pronoun is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿من﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) preposition with no grammatical position.
﴿حيث﴾: an adverb, indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by «من»; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿نستدرجهم﴾.
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿يعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the clause «لا يعلمون» is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿وأملي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «أملي» is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir).
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أملي﴾.
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿كيدي﴾: the noun of «إن», made accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, its appearance being prevented by the place being occupied by the vowel suited to the first-person yāʾ; the first-person yāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿متين﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «إن», made nominative (marfūʿ) by the overt ḍamma; the clause serves as the reason (taʿlīl) for the granting of respite.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿أم﴾: conjoined to what precedes; ﴿أم﴾ is a conjunction for transitional digression (al-iḍrāb al-intiqālī).
﴿تسألهم﴾: an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أجرًا﴾: a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «هم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿من مغرم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مثقلون﴾.
﴿مثقلون﴾: the khabar (predicate), made nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿أم﴾: conjoined to what precedes; ﴿أم﴾ is a conjunction for transitional digression (al-iḍrāb al-intiqālī).
﴿عندهم﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and the pronoun is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿الغيب﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿فهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «هم» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿يكتبون﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿فاصبر﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); «اصبر» is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت» (you).
﴿لحكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اصبر﴾.
﴿ربك﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is prohibitive.
﴿تكن﴾: an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by «لا»; its noun is latent, its implied form being «أنت».
﴿كصاحب﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the khabar (predicate) of «تكن», and «صاحب» is a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿الحوت﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إذ﴾: an adverb attached to an omitted muḍāf, the implied form being: «ولا يكن حالك مثل حال صاحب الحوت وقت ندائه» (and let not your state be like the state of the companion of the fish at the time of his calling out).
﴿نادى﴾: a past verb, the fāʿil being latent; the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿مكظوم﴾: the khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of «نادى».

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿لولا﴾: a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (ḥarf imtināʿ li-wujūd), containing the meaning of condition.
﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle.
﴿تداركه﴾: a past verb, and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿نعمة﴾: the fāʿil (agent); the verb is put in the masculine because the femininity of «النعمة» is not real.
﴿من ربه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نعمة﴾; «أن» together with what falls within its scope is in the place of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is necessarily omitted.
﴿لنبذ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of «لولا»; «نبذ» is a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو» (he).
﴿بالعراء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نبذ﴾.
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿مذموم﴾: the khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of «نبذ».

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿فاجتباه﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to an implied [clause], i.e.: «فأدركته نعمة من ربه فاجتباه» (then a favour from his Lord reached him, so He chose him); «اجتباه» is a past verb, and the pronoun is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ربه﴾: the fāʿil (agent), in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the hāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فجعله﴾: conjoined to ﴿فاجتباه﴾; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi.
﴿من الصالحين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object of «جعل».

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿وإن﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «إن» is lightened from the heavy [«إنّ»] and is inoperative (muhmala).
﴿يكاد﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba).
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the noun of «يكاد».
﴿كفروا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ليزلقونك﴾: the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); «يزلقونك» is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يزلقونك﴾ is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the khabar (predicate) of «يكاد».
﴿بأبصارهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يزلقونك﴾.
﴿لما﴾: linking, or a temporal adverb (ḥīniyya ẓarfiyya).
﴿سمعوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿الذكر﴾: a mafʿūl bihi; the apodosis (jawāb) of «لما» is omitted because [the context] indicates it, i.e.: «لما سمعوا الذكر كادوا يزلقونك» (when they heard the Reminder, they almost made you slip).
﴿ويقولون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «يقولون» is conjoined to «يزلقونك».
﴿إنه﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun.
﴿لمجنون﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «مجنون» is the khabar of «إن»; the clause is the object of their saying.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «ما» is negating and inoperative (muhmala), because its negation is broken by «إلا» «[Translator's note: the source has «لانتقاء» (absence), evidently a slip for «لانتقاض» (breaking).]».
﴿هو﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿ذكر﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «هو».
﴿للعالمين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ذكر﴾.
